patch_description:
Reduce parameter count and strengthen entanglement without increasing learnable parameters:
- Merge corner/edge RY into a shared "ry_perimeter" to enforce perimeter symmetry and reduce params.
- Replace the parametrized outer-ring CRZ with fixed CZ gates to add strong entanglement free of parameters.
- Keep trainable center-edge CRZs to allow distinct center coupling.
- Merge ZZZ row and column motifs into a shared "zzz_line" parameter (rows and columns often represent the same winning-line motif), keeping diagonal ZZZ separate.
- Merge post-RZ symmetry groups into a single "rz_post_perimeter" for all perimeter qubits.
This lowers N_PARAMS_per_block (improving parameter efficiency) while increasing gate-level entangling (via CZ) to preserve expressivity and encourage better generalization.
